PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-post-001.text: State parameter must be preserved in all OAuth redirect responses for CSRF protection.
PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-post-001.assertion: forall redirect(uri, err, state): state != undefined => result.searchParams.get('state') == state

locations.note: Lines 168-171: state added to URL params only if state is truthy — undefined/empty state silently omitted
Success redirect: callbackUrl.searchParams.set('state', state) — state always included in success path
